video_title: Figma Stock Analysis: Buy or Sell?

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: Third straight quarter of accelerating revenue growth: +48% year over year to $370 million, credited to AI credit consumption.
claims.evidence_text: In the most recent revenue accelerated 48% to $370 million

claims.speaker: host
claims.horizon_original: the rest of the full year
claims.reasoning_summary: Figma raised its full-year revenue outlook to 39% growth at the midpoint.
claims.evidence_text: Looking forward, the company raised its revenue outlook for the rest of the full year, forecasting revenue growth at 39% at the midpoint.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: Management kept profitability expectations unchanged and will invest for growth at the expense of margins.
claims.evidence_text: Still, the management team did not raise its expectations for profitability, informing investors that despite the impact on profit margins, the company is happy with investing in the business to grow revenue, gain competitive advantages even at the expense of margins.

claims.speaker: host
claims.condition: if it continues at this rate
claims.reasoning_summary: Growing revenue more than 3x Adobe's 13% rate (from a smaller base), gaining share against Adobe.
claims.evidence_text: Still, it's gaining market share against competitors like Adobe, and if it continues at this rate, it would be great news for investors.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: Operating cash flow to sales already fell from nearly 30% to 19.5%; with growth bought at the expense of margins it may keep falling.
claims.evidence_text: And given the management team's forecast for revenue growth at the expense of margins for the full fiscal year, it wouldn't surprise me if this margin continues falling.

claims.speaker: host
risks: Adobe and other larger competitors adding AI
claims.reasoning_summary: Larger competitors will respond with their own AI features, which could lower margins industry-wide.
claims.evidence_text: But larger competitors like Adobe are not likely to stand still. They're likely to create plans to implement these technologies into their services as well.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: Return on invested capital collapsed to -104.2% over the trailing twelve months.
claims.evidence_text: Over the trailing 12-month period, it collapsed to negative 104.2%.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: Growth bought with falling margins makes the revenue growth less impressive; he wants growth with improving margins.
claims.evidence_text: So this looked like a business that's investing aggressively in growth at the expense of margins. And so it makes the revenue growth look less impressive to me.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: The stock is down 37.88% year to date; investors are not impressed.
claims.evidence_text: And Figma stock is down 37.88% year-to-date in 2026.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: Forward P/E of 65.23 is near its historical low, relatively cheap versus its own history since April 2026.
claims.evidence_text: Figma is now trading at a forward price to earnings of 65.23, which is near the lowest this business has traded for according to this valuation metric.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: His March 20, 2026 evaluation said Figma did not look attractive, which he calls the correct decision.
claims.evidence_text: And my last evaluation of the business came on March 20th, 2026, when I informed investors that it didn't look very attractive at those prices.

claims.speaker: host
claims.reasoning_summary: His discounted cash flow model values Figma at $16.25 against a $23.20 close.
claims.evidence_text: I also updated my valuation for Figma using my discounted cash flow model, and I came to the conclusion that the business is worth $16.25. As of today's market close, it was trading at $23.20.

claims.speaker: host
claims.certainty_original: still does not look like an attractive buying opportunity
claims.reasoning_summary: Reiterates his ranking: not an attractive buy even after the drop.
claims.evidence_text: So despite the drop-off in share price, Figma stock still does not look like an attractive buying opportunity on the dip.

claims.speaker: host
claims.condition: a further dip in the share price, or an inflection point in the company's profit margins
claims.reasoning_summary: Would consider upgrading to a buy only after a further price dip or a margin inflection.
claims.evidence_text: I would wait for a further dip in the share price, or I would wait for an inflection point in the company's profit margins to consider upgrading this stock to a buying opportunity.
